blocks.content: Every motor vehicle must be registered before it is used on a public road. Registration is done at the Regional Transport Office (RTO).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Every driver is legally required to carry specified vehicle documents while driving.
Adherence to official vehicle registration rules is compulsory for all motor vehicles.
Proper documentation prevents legal penalties and ensures regulatory compliance.

cells: Proof that you are authorised to drive
Vehicle is fit to use on road

blocks.content: Note: Digital documents are legally accepted. Showing documents on DigiLocker or mParivahan app is valid under the 2019 Amendment.

items: Exams frequently test the exact list of mandatory documents drivers must carry under traffic laws.
Rules regarding vehicle registration procedures and validity are key scoring topics.
New vehicle: Register within 7 days of purchase
Registration Certificate (RC) must be renewed before expiry
Number plate must be clearly visible, as per standard format — no fancy plates
Vehicle colour and body must match what is registered
Modifications to vehicle structure require RTO approval
Selling a vehicle: Transfer of ownership must be reported to RTO within 30 days
